description:
About the Organization-
Impetus Technologies is a digital engineering company focused on delivering expert services and products to help enterprises achieve their transformation goals. We solve the analytics, AI, and cloud puzzle, enabling businesses to drive unmatched innovation and growth.
Founded in 1991, we are cloud and data engineering leaders providing solutions to fortune 100 enterprises, headquartered in Los Gatos, California, with development centers in NOIDA, Indore, Gurugram, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad with over 3000 global team members. We also have offices in Canada and Australia and collaborate with a number of established companies, including American Express, Bank of America, Capital One, Toyota, United Airlines, and Verizon.
Job Description
Role: ML & Generative AI Developer
Experience: 48 years
Locations- Bangalore / Hyderabad / Indore / Noida / Pune
The ML & Generative AI Developer will design, build, deploy, and optimize Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The role emphasizes hands-on development with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and agent-based AI systems, focusing on practical, production-ready implementations.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy ML and GenAI solutions for real-world use cases.
Build LLM-driven applications, including prompt engineering and RAG-based architectures.
Implement agentic AI workflows under the guidance of the Lead or Architect.
Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured data.
Integrate ML and GenAI components with backend systems and APIs.
Evaluate, monitor, and optimize model performance.
Adhere to best practices in coding standards, version control, and deployment.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Strong proficiency in Python programming.
Hands-on experience with Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP).
Practical experience with LLMs and GenAI frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex.
Solid understanding of RAG pipelines and vector databases.
Experience with ML frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn.
Basic knowledge of cloud platforms and containerization technologies.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and API development.

Job Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Location: Kochi
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to develop and improve ML-based vision systems for industrial applications.
Responsibilities
- Curate and maintain datasets for training computer vision models
- Train and optimize object detection models for various use cases
- Conduct technical feasibility assessments for new projects
- Oversee the annotation team to ensure data quality and consistency
- Analyze model performance and troubleshoot issues
Requirements
- 12 years of experience in computer vision or machine learning
- Proficiency with PyTorch and YOLO-based architectures
- Understanding of training parameters: learning rate, batch size, augmentation, hyperparameter tuning
- Experience with dataset management and annotation workflows
- Good communication skills for cross-team coordination
-Eagerness to learn, adapt, and work hands-on in a fast-paced startup setup
Nice to Have
- Experience with model optimization (quantization, pruning)
- Familiarity with ONNX export and inference runtimes

description:
Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe's all about. We give everyone-from emerging artists to global brands-everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We're passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We're on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!
What You Will Do
Develop, and deploy scalable AI/ML models including Bayesian Optimization, Reinforcement Learning, forecasting, and predictive modeling to address complex business challenges.
Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, hyper-parameter tuning, deployment, and monitoring
Work with large-scale datasets and complex codebases
Build and optimize deep learning models employing PyTorch, TensorFlow, and other modern ML/DL frameworks
Apply Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve client problems and integrate them into our internal tech stack
Collaborate with multi-functional teams including data engineers, ML scientists, and product managers to integrate AI/ML solutions into existing systems and applications
Conduct data analysis using SQL and other query languages to derive actionable insights and continuously improve model performance
Stay current with the latest advancements in AI/ML research, deployment practices, and tooling, and recommend adoption of relevant innovations.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
3-6 years of hands-on experience in end-to-end AI/ML project development using Python and libraries such as PySpark, Pandas, NumPy.
Strong foundations in classical machine learning algorithms and modern deep learning techniques.
Proven experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and other ML/DL frameworks for building and deploying production-grade models.
Solid understanding ofsoftware engineering principles (version control, testing, CI/CD) and ability to apply them to ML workflows.
Experience with data engineering concepts, including ETL pipelines, data workflows, and distributed computing.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Structured thinking and strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
A strong desire to learn, innovate, and deliver measurable business value through AI/ML solutions.
